newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: R&I directors welcome Axiom takeover bid.
newsitem.headline: R&I directors welcome Axiom takeover bid.

text.p: A takeover offer by Axiom Properties Ltd for Perth-based investment group Resource and Industry Ltd (RAI) was welcomed on Wednesday by R&I directors, RAI said.
"Axiom's proposal is welcomed by the directors of RAI who look forward to the Part A statement setting out full details in relation to the offers," RAI told the Australian Stock Exchange.

Axiom earlier on Wednesday said it was planning a bid, offering two fully paid shares in Axiom for every three R&I shares. R&I shareholders will also receive a total of 17 cents per share return of capital.
R&I shares rose four cents to 44 cents on Wednesday.
Axiom shares closed unchanged at 46 cents.
